start: Guy in the chair, reporting for duty. Hi, Harley.
Comms are hot, Harley. Snacks are hotter. Let's go.
Morning, tin can. I've got eyes on everything.
Chair's warm, screens are up. Your move, Harley.
suitUp: Suit's sealed. You look ridiculous. In a cool way.
Plates locked, Harley. Try not to dent the paint.
Armor's on. Dad would've added more lasers, honestly.
Suited up. Okay, that was kind of epic.
suitSwapIn: New suit! Give me a sec to learn its quirks.
Swap done, Harley. Same genius pilot, shinier shell.
Fresh armor online. I already love this one.
Suit changed. Don't worry, the chair adapts.
lowEnergy: Power's dipping, Harley. Grab an arc cell, please.
You're running on fumes. Land and recharge, hotshot.
Your reactor's cooking. Feet down before it quits.
Reactor's overheating, Harley. Land and let it cool.
lowHealth: Armor's shredded, Harley! Find a repair pack. Now!
You're hurt. I hate this part. Grab health.
Hey. Stay with me. Repair pack, two o'clock.
Health critical! Back off before I come out there.
toFlight: Wheels up! Try not to hit a pigeon.
Flight mode. Show-off. I love it.
Airborne, Harley. Energy drains up there, remember.
Up you go, tin can. Sky's all yours.
toGround: Landed. Nice and gentle. Nobody saw that wobble.
Feet on the floor. Battery's filling back up.
hulkbusterReady: Hulkbuster's ready! Press Q. Press it, Harley!
Big suit's charged. Go be a building.
Beacon's live. Time to get enormous.
Hulkbuster online. I've been waiting all day for this.
hulkbusterDeploy: Here comes the big one! Smash responsibly.
Twenty seconds of pure chaos. Make them count.
Hulkbuster deployed! Dum-E is literally applauding.
You're huge now, Harley. Punch everything.
waveStart: New wave incoming. I'm tagging targets now.
Here they come, Harley. Heads up.
Contacts on the scope. Let's get loud.
Next wave. You got this. Probably. Definitely.
droneSwarm: That's a lot of drones. Like, a LOT.
Swarm incoming! Keep moving, don't let them box you.
Drones everywhere, Harley. I'll jam what I can.
It's a drone party and you're the piñata.
tankSpotted: Tank bot! Shells arc, so strafe sideways.
Big tracks on the scanner. Hit the treads, Harley.
Tank spotted. It's slow, you're not. Use that.
Heavy armor rolling in. Don't stand still.
bossIncoming: Titan inbound. Okay. Breathe. We trained for this.
Big boss on radar, Harley. Chest seam's the weak spot.
The Obsidian Titan's here. Guy in the chair is ready.
Boss incoming! I'm pulling every scan I've got.
bossPhase2: Phase two! Missile pods online. Keep moving!
Armor's cracking, Harley. Missiles incoming, juke them!
It's angry now. Pods are tracking you.
Phase two. I'm jamming missile locks. Mostly.
bossPhase3: Phase three! It's ramming! Dodge, dodge, dodge!
It's charging at you. Sidestep and hit the core!
Last phase. You've got this. I've got you.
bossDefeated: IT'S DOWN! The chair is screaming!
Titan destroyed! Harley, you absolute legend!
We did it! Okay, you did it. I helped.
Boss down! Dad would be so proud of you.
combo: You're on fire. Not literally. Hopefully.
That combo's going in the highlight reel.
pickupHealth: Health's back up. Stop scaring me.
pickupEnergy: Energy's topped off, Harley. Fly free.
Power restored. Thrusters are happy again.
pickupHulkbuster: Beacon grabbed! Big suit's ready on Q.
Hulkbuster beacon! Oh, this is gonna be fun.
You found a beacon, Harley. Go get huge.
Beacon secured. Dum-E is warming up the big one.
death: Suit's down. I've got you. Get back up.
That was bad. We go again, together.
Ow. Okay. Shake it off, Harley. Round two.
highScore: New high score! I'm screenshotting this.
Best score ever. I'm telling everyone.
High score! U is doing a little dance.
idle: Hello? Chair to tin can, come in.
Taking a break? I'll just eat your snacks.
Still here. Still the guy in the chair.
hack: Hacked their targeting. They're shooting each other now.
I'm in. That was way too easy.
Firewall down. Guy in the chair strikes again.
intel: Scanning... weak point is the glowing seam.
Intel says three more behind that building.
Heads up, Harley. Hostiles flanking left.
Rerouting power to repulsors. Hit harder now.
encourage: Annoying big brother or not, I've got your back.
Breathe. You've beaten worse. I watched.
Dad built the suits. You make them heroes.
